questions.question: Tell me about yourself
questions.really_asking: Can you summarise why you fit, clearly and briefly?
questions.how_to_answer: Your elevator pitch: present role, relevant past, why this job next. About 60–90 seconds.

questions.question: Why this role, and why us?
questions.really_asking: Have you done your homework, and will you stay?
questions.how_to_answer: Two specific things about the company and how they match your experience and goals.

questions.question: Why are you leaving?
questions.really_asking: Is there a problem we should worry about?
questions.how_to_answer: Forward-looking and positive. Never criticise a past employer.

questions.question: What is your greatest strength?
questions.really_asking: Can you back up a claim?
questions.how_to_answer: One strength tied to the role, proved with a short STAR story.

questions.question: What is a weakness?
questions.how_to_answer: A real but non-critical weakness, plus what you are doing about it.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you failed
questions.really_asking: Do you own mistakes and learn?
questions.how_to_answer: STAR plus reflection. Spend most of the time on what you changed afterwards.

questions.question: Tell me about a conflict at work
questions.how_to_answer: STAR focused on how you resolved it and kept the relationship.

questions.question: Where do you see yourself in 3 years?
questions.really_asking: Is this role part of your plan?
questions.how_to_answer: Growth this role and company can realistically offer.

questions.question: What are your salary expectations?
questions.really_asking: Are we in the same range?
questions.how_to_answer: A researched range anchored on the advertised salary. You don't need to share your current pay.

questions.question: Can you explain this gap in your CV?
questions.really_asking: Is there anything to worry about?
questions.how_to_answer: Brief and honest, then move on to what you bring now.

questions.question: Do you have any questions for us?
questions.how_to_answer: Two or three prepared questions about the team, success in the role, or next steps.
